## Import



CLS remote write task can be imported using the composite id, e.g. the format is `topic_id#task_id`

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cls/remoteWriteTask:RemoteWriteTask example 3f5cc19d-f601-48b6-9671-9019b7b09bd0#e0e10aab-5977-49b3-a4dd-106db8821b6a
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
